2610.11794.title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
2610.11794.paper_summary: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.
2610.11794.paper_summary_zh: 學習在不熟悉的環境中行動需要代理推斷世界的運作方式，並在新證據到來時修正該理解。<lb/>然而，有限的觀察可以支持多種世界模型，這些模型解釋了過去的互動，但在未見狀態下預測不同的結果。<lb/>我們介紹 Memento 3，基於 Memento 系列，讓凍結的 LLM 代理能夠通過外部記憶持續學習明確的世界模型。<lb/>該代理維護一本自然語言的規則手冊作為持久的語義記憶，記錄關於環境動態的可修訂假設，同時對未知方面保持不確定。<lb/>它將這本規則手冊編譯成可執行的代碼以進行預測和規劃。<lb/>通過觀察、反思、規則修訂、編譯和驗證的持續循環，代理利用預測誤差來完善規則手冊及其代碼。<lb/>只有當 LLM 判斷更新的代碼忠實於規則手冊且單元精確重播再現觀察到的轉變時，更新的代碼才會被接受。<lb/>我們將這一過程視為基於模型的遞歸自我改進 (RSI) 路徑：代理自主探索環境，修訂其世界模型，並利用經過驗證的更新來指導後續的互動和學習，而基礎的 LLM 則保持不變。<lb/>一個人口擴展在平行維持多個世界模型，分享互動證據並利用它們的預測來指導探索。<lb/>在 ARC-AGI-3 上，單模型代理清除所有 25 個公共遊戲的每一級，達到平均相對人類行動效率 (RHAE) 100.0，並使用 44% 的人類行動計數。<lb/>在一個 Atari Pong 案例研究中，學習到的反饋控制器在三個評估的回合中以 21:0 贏得每一局，且開局不同，無需進一步的 LLM 調用。
